label: diffuse: weak lift after e input, on outputs m/t/i/p, late steps of long sequences
explanation: Sparse (about 1% of steps) but fires diffusely in both phases. The best lifts are prev_tok=e (6x), copy-phase output of m/t/i/p (4-5x), input 1 (4x), and the last original positions of L=8-9 sequences (orig_idx 7-8, 3-6x). It never fires at t=0 and seldom at the delimiter. Rate grows with L. No single predicate or small disjunction gets dev F1 above 0.12; the best was prev_tok==e in the original phase (P 0.10, R 0.15). Magnitude was not explained by any variable I checked.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (copy phase: 1, s, m, t; input phase: b, k, e, n; delimiter step: ) and the token being output (most: m, t, p, i, 1, 2; least: f, k, b, e); timing cues that raise it most: L=5 & t=4, L=9 & t=13, L=4 & t=2.
